verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Braintrust runs automated workflows such as scheduled Patterns, online scoring and CI/CD evals. However, nothing in the evidence shows those automations can be versioned, reviewed as changes, or rolled back. The versioning evidence covers datasets and immutable experiment records, which are different objects, so it does not transfer to automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
